events.title: Next Fest Demo update
events.summary: Hello everybody! Thanks to your huge interest in the demo, more than 50k unique players in two weeks, it's a huge achievement for us! We are very sorry for the problems with update launch at night of 17 October, now everything is fixed and playable After demo release we had something, we wanted to fix and update, so here it is.At first we focused on physics and graphics optimization. Also there were some problems with hoomans stucking, so fixed that too.Fixed fabrics, now they all work as intend

events.title: Playtest news update
events.summary: Dear community! We are deeply sorry for not posting news, we got troubles with fixing crucial problems with our build, so you can have pleasant experience with the content that we have right now.I believe that we are somewhere near finishing fixes and polishing, and the playtest will come out somewhere in a week.Again, we apologize for the unexpected delay and are doing everything possible to finish it as soon as we can!P.S. More than 1200 people want to participate!Thank you!

events.title: Playtest news
events.summary: Hey everyone!Thanks for lots of attention to our game. I'm happy to announce that there are 700 playtesters ready to deploy!It's an enormous number, as i see it, so it's really cool. Also, for each playtester we give 3 invites for friends!The playtest will be held in the 20th of April, so, in about two weeks. We want to polish last things, so you can test it out.I'm also thinking about some sort of feedback channel, but don't know exactly what it will actually be.But stay tuned, i'll contact you
